pathways.title: IMI KIS (Kartu Izin Start) pathway
steps: Register IMI membership (KTA) — MyIMI (myimi.id) is the 2026 membership portal; Gaspol by IMI has also been used for KTA / KIS
Obtain KIS (Kartu Izin Start) for the road-race / sportbike category required by the event
Complete medical / fitness documentation as required for the KIS category
Hold club or regional IMI affiliation (TKT / klub) where the event requires it
Enter IMI-sanctioned events and pass scrutineering under published IMI sporting / technical regulations
pathways.notes: High-level only — no invented clause numbers. Name the start permit KIS. MyIMI launched 1 Mar 2026 as IMI's membership hub; Gaspol still describes KIS issuance. Owner should confirm which portal is required for 2026 road-race KIS.
